title: Autonomy Condition Contract
$comment: Prospectively frozen intended autonomy configuration. It is not inferred from observed behavior, and confirmation semantics do not themselves establish an M1/M2/M3 treatment.

max_consecutive_agent_selected_actions.description: Maximum consecutive actions the agent may select without an autonomy-defined intervention.

intermediate_approval_required.$comment: Autonomy-level intervention declaration only; treatment authorization and approval remain separate control semantics.

action_horizon.description: Prospective conceptual action-selection horizon; it is distinct from the total run action budget.

action_budget.description: Prospective total action budget for this autonomy condition.
